author: ita_ipo
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619, CVSS 9.2) actively exploited — RCE in PHP core hits Drupal/Joomla/Magento/WordPress. Patch now. Also on CISA KEV today: Arista VeloCloud SQLi (CVE-2026-114625) & Collabora Online RCE (CVE-2026-110447).

author: devops_nk
text: October platform incidents: Microsoft Authenticator Android token theft flaw; Railway customer secrets exposure; LiteLLM malicious PyPI + Docker releases; Zeabur infrastructure breached; OpenCode AI API keys exposed; OVHcloud CLI...

author: sunset_evm
text: LiteLLM's supply chain attack traces back to a master key leaked on GitHub in May and never revoked. That key led to their Agent Platform, then a GitHub owner token, then a malicious PyPI release in October. A leaked secret isn't handled until it's rotated.

author: matricedigitale
text: Gheist steals GitHub secrets: 13,500 malicious branches and 850 compromised accounts (supply chain attack).

author: whodeven
text: With the Tensorlake npm 0.5.144 worm, researchers say revoking the stolen token could trigger a dead-man's switch that wipes the machine. Rotate keys, yes. Kill persistence first.

author: DailyCVEBrief
text: Monday's CVE Brief: 8 actively exploited, 13 critical, 71 high priority.

author: B2bCyber
text: Supply chain attack on ConnectWise Cloud Backup - Microsoft Threat Intelligence confirmed an active supply chain attack on the ConnectWise Cloud Backup OAuth application; attacker obtained access tokens.

author: privacyneedle
text: PHP2Shell RCE flaws are actively exploited in the wild, with attacks beginning days before emergency patches. Over 5 million PHP hosts remain exposed.

author: privacyneedle
text: Malicious files hidden in local Downloads folders are now targeting AI coding agents via indirect prompt injection, attempting to trick autonomous tools into installing harmful npm packages.

author: windowsforum
text: Over 1,400 CVEs in one Patch Tuesday from Microsoft; patch actively exploited CVE-2026-96951 first.

author: spotlightoncn
text: A China-aligned hacking group used an AI tool to accelerate cyberattacks against hundreds of organizations worldwide, including an incident involving ConnectWise, Microsoft said on Oct. 21.

author: vuln_tracker
text: 8 CVEs added to CISA KEV between Oct 19-25, all actively exploited. Plex, Arista, Collabora, Siemens and SiteGuard. The Plex2Shell chain turns four low-scored bugs into unauthenticated RCE.

author: EpochTimes
text: A hacking group aligned with the Chinese regime used an A.I. tool to accelerate cyberattacks against hundreds of organizations worldwide, including ConnectWise, Microsoft said.

author: SocXAInvaders
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day: CVE-2026-114625 is an actively exploited critical SQL injection in on-premises VeloCloud Orchestrator.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 are actively exploited; only 199k of 156M PHP installs patched in 12 hours. Disable session upload progress, verify PHP worker restarts, then patch.

author: primocollab
text: Microsoft says a China-aligned group used ARTEX, an agentic AI pen-testing tool, in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply chain attack.

author: rst_cloud
text: ovhcloud-cli security incident - October 19th, 2026. Threat: Glassworm. Victims: OVHcloud, cloud service customers, developer environments.

author: lucasverdan
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Zero-Day: CVE-2026-114625 is an actively exploited critical SQL injection in on-premises VeloCloud Orchestrator.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-96561 (CVSS 7.2) - AI Engine WordPress plugin <=3.8.0 vulnerable to Stored XSS via indirect prompt injection, executing when admins access dashboard.

author: SOCMinute
text: A malicious AGENTS.md file tricks AI coding agents into installing rogue npm packages, a novel supply chain attack.

author: gastronomy
text: Ulysses: A Security Harness For Synthesizing Verifiable Web Exploits - an AI agent that automatically discovers vulnerabilities and generates exploits.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH CVE-2023-54402 CVSS 7.5: iDocView SSRF flaw in /doc/upload endpoint. Hardcoded token bypasses auth. Actively exploited since Mar 2024.

author: ThomasHuffman79
text: Unit 42 retracts AI-agent claim on PHP2Shell: walked back its claim about an AI agent being behind a break-in at a European government using PHP2Shell.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Collabora Online / Nextcloud CODE Server: active exploitation confirmed. Update the Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server (richdocuments) app to version .303 or later immediately. CVE-2026-110447 (CISA KEV).

author: tchsignal
text: AI Agents and PHP2Shell: What the Evidence Actually Shows. Did AI agents actually exploit PHP2Shell? A critical correction to a security report means the answer is not established. CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.

author: david_x_ai
text: Pillar Security disclosed a critical bug in opencode, the open-source coding agent. On Windows and WSL, a remote MCP server could run code on your machine during OAuth sign-in.

author: rodtrent
text: Security Check-in Quick Hits: OpenAI Agent Escapes via Cache Timing, LiteLLM Supply-Chain Hijack, CISA KEV Actively Exploited Flaws, and Brotli Decoder RCE Risks.

author: theblaze156
text: CrateDepression: Rust supply-chain attack infects cloud CI pipelines (GitLab CI) with Go malware via typosquatting.

author: DefendtheFieldx
text: Handala Hack claims massive breach of Israeli 'Etype' audio intel platform developed by Malam.

author: PatchOnChain
text: MCP tool poisoning and rug pulls: a connected MCP server can exfiltrate AWS keys through its tool schema — Model Context Protocol's in-band poisoning flaw and agent supply chain attacks.

author: TuringCyberObs
text: CVE-2021-48017 affects OrbiTeam BSCW Server. The unauthenticated path traversal is actively exploited in the wild.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Gheist campaign plants secret-dumping GitHub Actions workflows across 850+ compromised accounts, exfiltrating CI/CD secrets and cloud credentials through GitHub's own API.

author: Stingrai_HQ

text: OpenCode's hosted Console was breached Oct 18. 1.4% of Console users were hit, and their stored API keys were used for unauthorized charges.
